description: This PHP class 'Setting' in the Opencart e-commerce platform manages retrieval of configuration settings from the database for specific stores. It includes methods to get all settings, individual settings, and specific values.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A model class for fetching store settings from the database in the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a specific store or default store (store_id=0).

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches key-value pairs of settings for a given store and code, decoding serialized data if needed.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific setting key for a store.
